name: Horticulture Mission for North Eastern Hill Scheme- Meghalaya
benefit:
> **Pattern of Assistance:**

Training, Awareness program, extension, Technology support, Subsidy on inputs, Improving marketability and marketing support.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Meghalaya.
1. The applicant should be a bonafide farmer engaged in agriculture.
1. The applicant should possess owned or leased land of at least 200 sqms.
